parties.metaTitle: Political Parties Approved for Haiti's 2026 Electoral Process
parties.metaDescription: Search the official CEP registry of 320 political parties published in July 2026, including approval status and source information.
parties.heading: Political parties registered for the 2026–2027 electoral process
parties.summary: The Conseil électoral provisoire (CEP) published this definitive registry of political parties reviewed for the next stages of Haiti's electoral process. Official party names and acronyms appear as published by the CEP.
parties.searchPlaceholder: Search by official name or acronym
parties.noResults: No parties match your search and status filter.
parties.qualificationNote: CEP status “Agréé” means a party was approved to continue to the next stages of the electoral process under Article 129 of the June 2, 2026 electoral decree. It does not confirm that the party has qualified candidates on the final ballot.
parties.sourceAnomaly: The CEP summary states 320 parties, but the published PDF table omits sequence rows 174, 202, and 309. Their names and acronyms require CEP confirmation; their approved status is inferred only from the published 316/4 totals.
parties.missingName: Source row absent — manual verification required
parties.noneFound: No platform found in the audit
parties.noPresenceFound: No official presence was found in the completed audit.
parties.methodology: Vwa verifies evidence that a party controls an online channel before labeling it official. We distinguish a substantive political platform from general political messaging and slogans. “None found” means an audit did not locate a platform; it is not proof that none exists. Pending discoveries are never shown as official links.

profile.metaDescription: Official CEP information, published digital-presence research, platforms, candidates, and sources for {party}.
profile.vwaResearchNotice: This section contains VWA research that has completed human review. CEP publications remain authoritative for electoral status.
profile.reviewPending: VWA has not yet completed its digital-presence review for this party.
profile.noPresenceFound: No verified official presence was located during the completed review. This does not prove that none exists.
profile.platformFull: Substantive political platform or program published
profile.platformNoneFound: No platform was located during the completed review. This is not proof that none exists.
profile.platformUnknown: Platform classification has not been completed.
profile.candidatesUnavailable: Candidate information for this party is not yet available from the applicable CEP publications.
